source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.2 (PDF 222), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Creativity naye aur apne (original) andaaz mein sochne ki salahiyat hai. Is mein imagination (zehan mein nayi baatein soch lene ki taqat) se aise ideas paida kiye jate hain jo aam se mukhtalif hon. Creativity sirf artists ya inventors (nayi cheezein banane walon) tak hi nahi; yeh har field (shoba) mein qeemti skill hai, science aur engineering se le kar karobar aur taleem tak. Bohat se Pakistani karobar customers ko apni taraf lane ke liye apni marketing mein creativity istemal karte hain.

Misal: local (Pakistani) brands ne aisi impactful (gehra asar karne wali) advertising campaigns (ishtihar ki muhim) banayi hain jo na sirf un ke products ki promotion karti hain balke sunne aur dekhne walon se jazbati rishta (emotional connection) bhi banati hain.

blocks.prompt: Art ke ilawa kisi aur field se creativity ki ek misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan kisi engineer ka pani saaf karne ka sasta tareeqa dhoondna, ya kisi dukaandar ka home delivery ka naya idea.

items: Creativity: naye aur original andaaz mein sochna; har field mein kaam aati hai, marketing mein bhi.
